name: 4C-D
toxicities: The exact toxic dose is unknown; recreational toxicity has not been studied in a scientific setting.

generalRisks: Recreational toxicity and long-term health effects have not been studied in a scientific setting, human-use history is very limited, and the exact toxic dose is unknown.
longtermRisks: Long-term health effects have not been established; the source says they have not been studied in a scientific setting.
addictionPotential: 4C-D as not readily habit-forming and possibly self-regulating, but this is based on limited anecdotal information.

tolerance.full: Tolerance is reported to develop almost immediately after ingestion.

summary: 4C-D, also known as Ariadne, is a synthetic phenethylamine in the 2C family. It has limited documented human use, and its effects are not well characterized.
